reason: This plugin is primarily a conversation-queue automation utility for the DSH web interface: it lets users reorder pending messages in the queue and trigger queue-wide actions before agent execution. Evidence from the repository description, README, and package manifest consistently describes queue reordering features plus a companion host endpoint used to update queue state.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 网页插件，用于在代理处理前手动调整消息队列顺序，并支持消息的上下、置顶/置底与拖拽重排。
summaries.en: This DeepSeek Harness web plugin lets users reorder queued messages before processing, including moving items up/down or to the top/bottom, with queue-level actions in the UI.

capabilities: Reorders pending conversation messages in the DSH queue before the agent processes them.
Adds client-side queue controls (up/down/top/bottom and drag-and-drop) in the conversation UI.
Provides bulk queue actions to send all queued items and clear the queue via plugin UI and host route.

reasons.code: README and repository description state the plugin is for reordering queued messages in DSH before agent processing with up/down/top/bottom and drag-to-reorder controls.
README documents a host endpoint POST /queue-director/api/reorder that mutates agent.inbox order via splice and a client module that redraws the queue strip.
package.json declares DSH web bundle patch/client injection, confirming this is a web plugin with runtime UI/runtime integration.
